guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot describe the photo to a buyer.

guidance.merchant_action: Add relevant tags for the product.
guidance.what_is_missing: The product has no tags.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot group or find the product by tag.

guidance.merchant_action: Supply the brand name for the product.
guidance.what_is_missing: The product has no brand.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot identify the brand of the product.

guidance.merchant_action: Supply the numeric stock quantity, if the store tracks it.
guidance.what_is_missing: Only a yes or no stock flag is present. No numeric stock quantity is present.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot tell how many units are left.

guidance.merchant_action: Supply the GTIN, if the product has one.
guidance.what_is_missing: No GTIN is in the product record.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot match the product across stores by GTIN.

guidance.merchant_action: Supply shipping rates and policy at checkout level, where shipping is set.
guidance.what_is_missing: No shipping rates or shipping policy are in the product record.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot quote shipping for the product.

guidance.merchant_action: Supply the tax rule at checkout level, where tax is set.
guidance.what_is_missing: No tax rate or tax rule is in the product record.
guidance.why_it_matters: An agent cannot quote tax for the product.

guidance.merchant_action: No action is required from this audit item. A separate schema check is needed to verify it.
guidance.what_is_missing: Product schema was not checked by this audit.
guidance.why_it_matters: This audit does not claim schema is present or absent, so no merchant action is claimed here.
